exploratory_authorization.interpretation_boundary: The exploratory arenas cannot retroactively pass frozen validation, promote the arm, or authorize Phase 2.

reliability_event.cause: legacy Hero1 run config predated two policy-teacher provenance fields
reliability_event.fix: Allow those fields to be absent in legacy model configs while preserving explicit fixed-teacher fields on the candidate.
reliability_event.verification: 10 maintained Torch arena tests passed and the exact sealed Hero1 config validated unchanged

movement_audit.interpretation: The immutable teacher constrained update magnitude modestly more than the moving teacher, but did not simply freeze the trunk; visible changed fraction remained comparable.

supported: Immutable Hero1 supervision can turn the faster FP32/WSD recipe into a much stronger one-pass DFM player than the matched 554-update Hero1 Phase-1 control on the sealed development arena.
The gain is not explained by a stronger native policy alone: policy-only play is inconclusive at 0.443 while full DFM play is confirmed superior at 0.713.
The fixed teacher constrains encoder and policy-head movement more than the moving teacher.
not_supported: Formal model promotion or Phase 2 continuation under the sealed preregistration.
Superiority to the terminal one-epoch Hero1 artifact, which was not the arena opponent.
A claim of absolute Elo or held-out generalization beyond the frozen development opening pool.
A claim that illegal probability mass caused the JEPA regression or matters directly after legal masking.
remaining_risks: Frozen JEPA positive loss regressed from 0.19712 to 0.24134 and exceeded its 0.20712 noninferiority bound.
WDL ECE worsened even though WDL loss, accuracy, and Brier score were acceptable or improved.
The DFM arena is development-tier and its first 128 pairs have now been inspected.
Both arena participants are 554-update Phase-1 checkpoints, so terminal full-run strength remains unmeasured.

next_step.checkpoint_role: retain as the Hero2 Phase-1 continuation candidate and a targeted Raw/matched-Hero1-Phase1/candidate diff target
next_step.formal_promotion_requirement: Run a newly preregistered non-overlapping Phase-1 strength confirmation, then require equivalent-boundary and ultimately terminal one-epoch Hero1 comparisons before calling a full-run artifact promoted Hero2.
next_step.training_requirement: Before any coefficient arm, extend the no-update gradient audit to decompose immutable-teacher KL versus JEPA and the remaining representation objectives by parameter group.
next_step.single_followup_rule: Use that audit to preregister one balancing intervention: either a lower or decaying teacher coefficient if conflict is broadly scalar, or stop/scale teacher gradients into the encoder if conflict is trunk-localized. Do not run a post-hoc coefficient sweep.
next_step.interpretability_rule: Targeted Raw/matched-Hero1-Phase1/candidate model diffing may start now; reserve the full Raw/terminal-Hero1/Hero2 confirmatory stack for the longer artifact that clears independent strength confirmation and the chosen representation guardrail.
